title: Sacred Remembering - Homeward Practice

blocks.label: Text: Receiving the gift, carrying forward what gives life.
blocks.value: Receiving the gift, carrying forward what gives life.

blocks.label: Text: Set aside ten quiet minutes. You may want a journal nearby. Remembering …
blocks.value: Set aside ten quiet minutes. You may want a journal nearby. Remembering is not pretending the past was perfect. It is receiving what gave life, naming what needs to mature, and choosing what you want to carry forward with Jesus.

blocks.label: Text: Let your shoulders soften. Take one slow breath. Remember that God is al…
blocks.value: Let your shoulders soften. Take one slow breath. Remember that God is already present with you and within your story.

blocks.label: Text: Bring to mind one person, place, practice, or moment through which faith…
blocks.value: Bring to mind one person, place, practice, or moment through which faith first felt real, safe, or beautiful. Do not force an answer. Let one memory come.

blocks.label: Text: Ask gently: What gift did I receive? What image of God came with it? Wha…
blocks.value: Ask gently: What gift did I receive? What image of God came with it? What still gives life? What may need to grow or become more honest?

blocks.label: Text: Thank God for the gift. Release what no longer serves love. Ask Jesus fo…
blocks.value: Thank God for the gift. Release what no longer serves love. Ask Jesus for grace to carry forward what is true, life-giving, and freely chosen.

blocks.label: Heading: Try this for seven days.
Text: Each day, remember one gift and write one line: “Thank you for...” The a…
blocks.value: Each day, remember one gift and write one line: “Thank you for...” The aim is not nostalgia. It is a more conscious, grateful, and lived faith.

meta_description: A guided ten-minute practice for receiving the gifts in your spiritual story and carrying forward what gives life.
